description_en: Obtain the API call report based on the API name and the start and end times, and return the results aggregated by day or hour according to the specified group parameter
description_zh: 根据API名及开始结束时间获取API调用报表，并根据传入的group按照天或者小时聚合计算后返回
kebab_example: aliyun alimt get-translate-report --begin-time 2021-03-01_00:00:00 --end-time 2021-03-01_23:59:59 --api-name translate_standard --group 'hour或者day' --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
